title: What Is It?
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 1 Lesson 4. Official human conversation audio and matching dialogue. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Pete, hi! Hi, we are here!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: Hi, Anna! Hi, Marsha!
dialogue.translation_ar: أهلًا يا آنا! أهلًا يا مارشا!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Hi!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: How are you two?

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: I am great!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: You know, Pete, I am new to D.C. The city is big.
dialogue.translation_ar: تعرف يا بيت، أنا جديدة في واشنطن. المدينة كبيرة.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: Yeah. But you learn a little more every day. How's the new apartment?
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، لكنك تتعلمين المزيد كل يوم. كيف حال الشقة الجديدة؟

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: The new apartment is great! Let's get coffee!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Anna, do you have a pen?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Yes. I have a pen in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I have a …

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: It is not a pen. It is a book. It is a big book.
dialogue.translation_ar: هذا ليس قلمًا، بل كتاب كبير.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Yes. Yes it is, Pete. I know I have a pen, though…
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم يا بيت، أعرف ذلك. لكنني أعلم أن لدي قلمًا...

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I have a ....

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: It is not a pen, Anna ... a toy?
dialogue.translation_ar: هذا ليس قلمًا يا آنا... أهي لعبة؟

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I have a ....

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: And it is a pillow!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Pete, Marsha, I know I have a pen.
dialogue.translation_ar: يا بيت ومارشا، أعلم أن لدي قلمًا.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Anna, it is a map.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: Why do you have a map of the world?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Pete, Marsha. Now I know I have a pen.
dialogue.translation_ar: يا بيت ومارشا، الآن أعرف أن لدي قلمًا.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: And now you have a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Anna.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I have a pen! Let’s get coffee!
